summary: move the stage modules into a package
pull_request_body: Move every module of the stage prefix into the stage package. The plan keeps every import line and every caller, so the move changes no behavior that a consumer observes.
why: Issue #3372: the stage plan moves only some of the stage modules and verifies one sampled import, so the layout test fails on the tree that the plan produces.
what_changes: Move every module of the stage prefix into `src/devops_cli/roadmap/stage/`.
Verify the moved prefix with a negative search that no created module keeps.
feasibility: The staged tree holds every module of the stage prefix, and the plan lists each one in `changes`.
A search for `devops_cli.roadmap.stage` matches the old `stage.py` import lines and every new path under the `stage/` package.
existing_tool: The tree walk of `StagedTree` and the `git mv` of the step cover the need, so the plan builds no tool.

groups.title: Move the stage modules into a package
groups.implementation: Move every module of the stage prefix into the stage package
